central_problem: planner 寫著 3/3，實際 side effects 卻可能 fan out；budget 到底應該由誰負責？
reader_takeaway: execution budget 必須在每個外部 side effect 前由單一 ledger 授權，並計入 retry、resolver、redirect、materialization 與 fallback。

known_at_the_time.fact: current worktree authoritative-execution-budget.ts defines typed query/provider/request/retry/redirect/resolver/materialization/fallback/elapsed-time accounting。
V5 audit passed canonical binding and budget authority with zero mismatches, overruns and hidden attempts。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: V5 fresh cohort recorded 10/10 terminal, 1/10 canonical direct-study coverage, 0/10 qualifying-full-text coverage and zero Writer requests。

not_yet_available.fact: V5 control-plane READY did not mean generalization or content READY。

observed_failures.symptom: a nominal 3-query/3-provider plan hid a much larger actual attempt fan-out
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: limits were declared at planning layer instead of reserved before external side effects
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: audit must count actual attempts, aliases and retries
observed_failures.later_resolution: authoritative ledger reserves/deduplicates/blocks operations before side effects

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The V5 audit recorded 0 canonical mismatches, 0 budget overruns and 0 hidden attempts; its cohort had 1/10 direct-study and 0/10 qualifying-full-text coverage.
tests_and_metrics.result: budget authority audit passed while content generalization remained not ready

engineering_decisions.decision: 建立一個 execution ledger 作為 budget authority，讓每個 operation 先 reserve，超限就 typed BLOCKED_BY_BUDGET。

architecture_state.state: query plan → authoritative execution ledger → provider/resolver/materialization side effects → canonical audit

safe_numbers.value: 0 canonical mismatches, 0 budget overruns, 0 hidden attempts

safe_numbers.meaning: same fresh cohort; content remained not ready

safe_public_facts.fact: retry、fallback 與 resolver 都是成本與風險，不應只在 planner 裡寫一個理想數字。

retrospective_notes.note: V5 把 control plane 收緊後，content coverage 仍然低；這不是矛盾，而是控制正確與材料不足的兩個結果。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: fan-out finding that motivates budget authority

publication_risks: 不要公開足以重現 private provider calls 的 budget/URL 細節。
V5 READY 必須加上 control-plane 限定。
